name: personal-browser-operator
description: Private goal-driven browser operator backed by a persistent Playwright Chromium session and a verifiable MCP control loop.

interface.longDescription: Give ChatGPT a browser goal and let the operator navigate real websites through a persistent Playwright session with durable task state, risk policy, effect idempotency, verification, recovery, and protected human takeover.
defaultPrompt: Use my Personal Browser Operator to complete this browser task safely and verify the result.
Open my persistent browser session, inspect the current page, and continue the task from the verified state.
